title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-08-01 20:35:17 最新章节：第7906章 空气太敏感
slug: 惊天剑帝第7906章空气太敏感
content_zh:
蛮古大陆，武魂是每一个武者修行的必备因素。
武魂分为品级，又低到高：黄，玄，地，天，帝，神。
“林白哥哥，你的魂力越来越强，以你现在的天赋，今天的武魂觉醒，至少都是地级武魂吧。“
林家的小道上，一个可人的少女，亲昵的挽着身边春风得意的少年笑着。
这少女名叫林紫儿，是林家大长老之女，自幼天赋异禀，誉为灵犀城中的第一天才少女，而身边的男子，正是她自幼的玩伴之一，林白。
林白，是前一任家主林铎的独子，自幼也展惊人的武道天赋，他和林紫儿并称为灵犀城的“金童玉女”。
“这些年来吃了那么多父亲留下来的养魂丹，魂力有了很大的提升，我也觉得我的武魂已经是地级以上的。”林白微微一笑的说到，目光坚定，闪烁异样光芒。
从林白的目光中就可以看出，林白对于今天的武魂觉醒，十分的看中。
“一旦我觉醒了地级以上的武魂，我就可以有足够的实力，去找我父亲了。当年父亲不告而别，我怀疑是和我娘亲有关。”林白慢慢的说道。
林紫儿乖巧的笑着：“林白哥哥，不管林铎伯伯是为了什么事情不告而别，我相信以林白哥哥的天资，一定可以找到他的，还有一定会找到你的娘亲的。”
“嗯，走吧，紫儿，时候不早了，我们该去演武场了。”
林紫儿乖巧一笑，一副亲昵的模样，牵着林白的手，走入了演武场去。
……
走入林家演武场，人山人海的弟子等待着觉醒。
“武魂觉醒，现在开始！”
“林海，上来觉醒吧。”
演武场中有一方高台，其上摆放着一颗巨大的黑色的石头，这便是武魂石。
听见喊声，一个身体健硕的少年，一脸兴奋的走上武魂石，将双手按在武魂石上片刻，随后黑色的武魂石上亮起了一阵赤色的光芒。
“林海，黄极五品武魂，迅雷猎豹！”
那名叫林海的弟子，听见自己是黄级五品的武魂，当即激动得哭了出来：“哈哈哈，我是黄级五品，黄级五品，哈哈，我要成武者了，我要成绝世高手了！”

黄级五品的武魂，在林家的弟子中，已经不低了。
林海在武者们羡慕的目光中走下了高台。
“下去吧，下一个，林紫儿。”
长老呼喊道。
林紫儿对林白展颜一笑：“林白哥哥，我去了。”
林白笑道：“去吧，加油。”
“嗯嗯。”
林紫儿乖巧的点头一下，走上了高台上去。
林紫儿双手按在武魂石上不久，一阵冲天的红色光柱，注入苍穹，让方圆万里之内的所有武者，都能看见这一道红光！
“红光冲霄！是天级！”
“天级武魂！”
“我的天，当年的林铎也不过才是地级呀，林紫儿居然是天级！”
站在武魂石旁边的长老，被这道红光吓得瞠目结舌，半天之后才回过神来，惊呼道：“林紫儿，林紫儿，林紫儿，天级五品！”
“林紫儿，天级五品武魂，洪荒神女道！”
“天级五品！”
“洪荒神女道，这是什么武魂啊！”
林白听见周围的惊呼声音，淡然的说到：“洪荒神女道，是有资格成为神级武魂的存在，一旦武魂觉醒，就会被赐予独特的修炼之术，这应该算是天级武魂中的前百武魂了！”
“紫儿妹妹果然没有让我失望。”
林白笑道：“紫儿妹妹的魂力还不如我，既然她都觉醒了天级武魂，那我的魂力比她强，那我的武魂，岂不是……”
想到这里，林白激动得口干舌燥。
content_en:
In the ancient continent, martial arts were an essential factor for every warrior to practice.
Martial spirits are divided into levels, from low to high: Huang, Xuan, Earth, Heaven, Emperor, and God.
"Brother Lin Bai, your soul power is getting stronger and stronger. With your current talent, the martial arts awakened today will at least be earth-level martial arts."
On the path of the Lin family, a lovely girl hugged the proud young man next to her and smiled.
This girl's name is Lin Zi'er. She is the daughter of the eldest elder of the Lin family. She has been gifted since she was a child and is known as the number one genius girl in Lingxi City. The man next to her is one of her childhood playmates, Lin Bai.
Lin Bai is the only son of the previous head of the family, Lin Duo. He has also shown amazing talent in martial arts since he was a child. He and Lin Zi'er are known as the "golden boys and girls" of Lingxi City.
"I have eaten so many soul-nurturing pills from my father over the years, and my soul power has greatly improved. I also feel that my martial soul is already above the earth level." Lin Bai said with a slight smile, his eyes firm and shining with a strange light.
It can be seen from Lin Bai's eyes that Lin Bai is very optimistic about today's martial arts awakening.
"Once I awaken the martial spirit above the earth level, I will have enough strength to go find my father. When my father left without saying goodbye, I suspect it has something to do with my mother." Lin Bai said slowly.
Lin Zier smiled obediently: "Brother Lin Bai, no matter what reason Uncle Lin Duo left without saying goodbye, I believe that with Brother Lin Bai's talent, we will definitely be able to find him, and we will definitely find your mother."
"Well, let's go, Zi'er, it's getting late, we should go to the martial arts field."
Lin Zi'er smiled cutely, looked affectionate, held Lin Bai's hand, and walked into the martial arts field.
…
Walking into the Lin Family Martial Arts Arena, there was a huge crowd of disciples waiting for their awakening.
"Martial spirit awakens, start now!"
"Lin Hai, come up and wake up."
There is a high platform in the martial arts arena, and a huge black stone is placed on it. This is the martial spirit stone.
Hearing the shout, a strong young man walked up to the Spirit Stone with an excited look on his face, pressed his hands on the Spirit Stone for a moment, and then a burst of red light lit up on the black Spirit Stone.
"Lin Hai, Huang Ji fifth-grade martial spirit, Thunder Leopard!"
When the disciple named Lin Hai heard that he was a fifth-grade Huang-level martial soul, he was so excited that he cried: "Hahaha, I am a fifth-grade Huang-level martial soul, a fifth-grade Huang-level soul. Haha, I am going to become a warrior, I am going to become a peerless master!"
The fifth-grade Huang-level martial spirit is already quite high among the disciples of the Lin family.
Lin Hai walked off the platform in the envious eyes of the warriors.
"Go down, next, Lin Zi'er."
the elder shouted.
Lin Zier smiled at Lin Bai: "Brother Lin Bai, I'm going."
Lin Bai smiled and said: "Go ahead, come on."
"Yeah."
Lin Zier nodded obediently and walked up to the high platform.
Not long after Lin Zier pressed her hands on the Spirit Stone, a burst of red light shot into the sky, allowing all warriors within a radius of thousands of miles to see this red light!
"The red light shoots into the sky! It's heaven-level!"
"Heaven-level martial spirit!"
"My God, Lin Duo was only at the Earth level back then, but Lin Zi'er is actually at the Heaven level!"
The elder standing next to the martial spirit stone was so frightened by the red light that he came back to his senses after a long time and exclaimed: "Lin Zi'er, Lin Zi'er, Lin Zi'er, fifth grade of heaven level!"
"Lin Zi'er, a heaven-level fifth-grade martial spirit, a prehistoric goddess!"
"Fifth level heaven level!"
"The Primordial Goddess said, what kind of martial spirit is this!"
Lin Bai heard the exclamations around him and said calmly: "The Primordial Goddess is a being who is qualified to become a god-level martial soul. Once the martial soul awakens, it will be given a unique cultivation technique. This should be regarded as one of the top 100 heaven-level martial souls!"
"Sister Zi'er really didn't disappoint me."
Lin Bai smiled and said: "Sister Zi'er's soul power is not as good as mine.If she has awakened a heaven-level martial spirit, then my soul power is stronger than hers, so my martial spirit is..."
Thinking of this, Lin Bai was so excited that his mouth went dry.
